e.title: PE Pricing Analytics
e.summary: 保险定价分析工作坊（Katrien Antonio，30★）：KU Leuven 的 R 定价课程材料——GAM/GLM/GBM 定价工作流
e.summary_en: Insurance pricing analytics workshop (Katrien Antonio, 30★): KU Leuven R pricing course materials — GAM/GLM/GBM pricing workflows
e.summary_hk: 保險定價分析工作坊（Katrien Antonio，30★）：KU Leuven 的 R 定價課程材料——GAM/GLM/GBM 定價工作流
e.body: PE-pricing-analytics（Katrien Antonio、Roel Henckaerts、Roel Verbelen，30★）是 KU Leuven 的《Pricing analytics in R》课程材料：GAM/GLM/GBM 定价工作流的实操工作坊——精算学术界（Katrien Antonio 权威）的定价教学。对 RIAA：定价实操课程——[[pc-pricing-tutorial]]（kasaai 定价教程）的 KU Leuven 版；GAM/GLM/GBM 定价工作流（[[insurancerating]]、[[insurance-gam]] 的教学配套）；Katrien Antonio 学术背书（[[workshop-loss-reserv-fraud]] 同作者）；与 [[loss-data-analytics]]（LDA 教材）配套；适合定价方向的自学与教学。
e.body_en: PE-pricing-analytics (Katrien Antonio, Roel Henckaerts, Roel Verbelen, 30★) is the course material of 'Pricing analytics in R' at KU Leuven: a hands-on workshop of GAM/GLM/GBM pricing workflows — pricing teaching from the actuarial academy (Katrien Antonio is an authority). For RIAA: a hands-on pricing course — the KU Leuven version of [[pc-pricing-tutorial]] (kasaai pricing tutorial); GAM/GLM/GBM pricing workflows (teaching companion of [[insurancerating]] and [[insurance-gam]]); academic backing of Katrien Antonio (same author as [[workshop-loss-reserv-fraud]]); pairs with [[loss-data-analytics]] (LDA textbook); suits self-study and teaching in pricing.
e.body_hk: PE-pricing-analytics（Katrien Antonio、Roel Henckaerts、Roel Verbelen，30★）是 KU Leuven 的《Pricing analytics in R》課程材料：GAM/GLM/GBM 定價工作流的實操工作坊——精算學術界（Katrien Antonio 權威）的定價教學。對 RIAA：定價實操課程——[[pc-pricing-tutorial]]（kasaai 定價教程）的 KU Leuven 版；GAM/GLM/GBM 定價工作流（[[insurancerating]]、[[insurance-gam]] 的教學配套）；Katrien Antonio 學術背書（[[workshop-loss-reserv-fraud]] 同作者）；與 [[loss-data-analytics]]（LDA 教材）配套；適合定價方向的自學與教學。
